sfx.name: water-3
sfx.about: Waterga: the tide comes in — a deep surge, twin swells, wide spray, and a crash that empties the room.

sfx.name: holy-2
sfx.about: Grand Holy: a peal of tubular bells inside a wide choir chord, with the soprano over the top.

sfx.name: gravity
sfx.about: Demi: space folding inward — a descending hollow tone and air dragged after it.

sfx.name: gravity-2
sfx.about: Demi at full weight: the same collapse, slower, ending on an impact that flattens the floor.

sfx.name: flare
sfx.about: Flare: everything collapses toward one point, holds for an instant, and detonates white-hot.

sfx.name: ultima
sfx.about: Ultima: a long gathering, a detonation that takes the room with it, and light still falling afterwards.

sfx.name: bio
sfx.about: Bio: something viscous, bubbling low in the field, with a sickly held note inside it.

sfx.name: death
sfx.about: Death: a cold choir breath falling away, one bell tolled underneath, and nothing else.

sfx.name: doom-tick
sfx.about: Doom: one small bell on the 2, struck as if by a clock, with the hall too quiet around it.

sfx.name: drain
sfx.about: Drain: air and choir pulled backwards out of the target and into the caster.

sfx.name: osmose
sfx.about: Osmose: the same siphon an octave up and made of glass — thin, cold and quick.

sfx.name: meteor
sfx.about: Meteor: three whistles falling out of the sky at different distances, and three impacts under them.

sfx.name: cure-2
sfx.about: Cura: the healing bloom with a fuller chord under it and the harp taking a longer run.

sfx.name: cure-3
sfx.about: Curaga: light comes down on the whole party — full choir, a harp sweep, bells, and warmth underneath.

sfx.name: regen
sfx.about: Regen: the same mote of light three times over, slower each time, promising to come back.

sfx.name: life
sfx.about: Life: a warm choir swell lifting from the b6 to the tonic, and one bell as they stand up.

sfx.name: full-life
sfx.about: Full-Life: the same rising, opened out to the full chord with a peal of three bells over it.

sfx.name: esuna
sfx.about: Esuna: a glass sweep upward as the ailment lets go, and a breath after it.

sfx.name: dispel
sfx.about: Dispel: a glass dome cracked once and let go — bright, then nothing left to ring.

sfx.name: protect
sfx.about: Protect: a low bell and a held chord closing around the target like a shield taking weight.

sfx.name: shell
sfx.about: Shell: the same gesture made of air and glass instead of weight — a dome, not a wall.

sfx.name: reflect
sfx.about: Reflect: two glass notes a fifth apart, the second a mirror of the first, ringing together.

sfx.name: reflect-bounce
sfx.about: A spell comes back off the mirror: the same glass reversed, thrown across the field.

sfx.name: haste
sfx.about: Haste: glass ticks accelerating up the triad until they blur into one shimmer.

sfx.name: slow
sfx.about: Slow: the same ticks decelerating and sagging — the tape losing speed rather than a pitch bend.

sfx.name: stop
sfx.about: Stop: a tick that is cut off mid-ring, and a frozen shimmer standing where it was.

sfx.name: sleep
sfx.about: Sleep: three drowsy notes falling a step at a time, the last one barely arriving.

sfx.name: silence
sfx.about: Silence: everything is pulled inward and the room is shut — a reversed swell into no tail at all.

sfx.name: blind
sfx.about: Blind: a dark smoky pass across the eyes, low and soft, with the light going out of the top.

sfx.name: poison
sfx.about: Poison: a sickly held note wobbling a quarter-tone under the 2, with slow bubbles in it.

sfx.name: berserk
sfx.about: Berserk: low brass and strings surge up together and refuse to resolve.

sfx.name: confuse
sfx.about: Confuse: one glass figure spiralling through the pitch set, never landing where it should.

sfx.name: curse
sfx.about: Curse: the b6 and the 2 struck together low and left to grind — the one deliberate dissonance.

sfx.name: scan
sfx.about: Scan: a thin sweep with three small readings taken along it, clinical and quiet.

sfx.name: steal-success
sfx.about: Steal: a quick grab of cloth and a bright little jingle getting away with it.

sfx.name: steal-fail
sfx.about: Nothing in the hand: the same grab, then a dull pizzicato thud where the jingle should be.

sfx.name: item-use
sfx.about: An item: a cork, a small glass bottle, and one mote of light leaving it.

sfx.name: phoenix-down
sfx.about: Phoenix Down: a feather turning over in the air, then warmth arriving underneath it.

sfx.name: elixir
sfx.about: Elixir: everything a cure does, unhurried, with the bells allowed to ring all the way out.

sfx.name: mp-restore
sfx.about: MP comes back: a cool blue shimmer filling from the bottom of the triad upward.

sfx.name: buff-generic
sfx.about: Something good lands: two glass notes rising to the tonic over a warm chord. Always upward.

sfx.name: debuff-generic
sfx.about: Something bad lands: two glass notes falling to the b6 over low strings. Always downward, never harsh.

sfx.name: summon-depart
sfx.about: The aeon leaves: the arrival played backwards — weight lifting, light going up and away.

sfx.name: aeon-overdrive
sfx.about: An aeon's Overdrive: a long charge under a tremolo climb, then the choir arriving with the whole orchestra.

sfx.name: wind-high-altitude
sfx.about: Summit wind: a cold low bed with one thin keening line drifting slowly across it.

sfx.name: wind-gust
sfx.about: One gust: it arrives, whistles past from left to right, and takes the top of the field with it.

sfx.name: kimahri-roar
sfx.about: A Ronso cries out in grief, not threat: a torn falling line over breath, and it breaks at the end.

sfx.name: fayth-hum
sfx.about: The fayth: the hymn's four-note head sung wordlessly, harmonised underneath, hanging in the air.

sfx.name: dome-echo
sfx.about: One sound in a stone hall: a struck bell answered three times, each answer darker and further away.

sfx.name: yu-yevon-chant
sfx.about: A chant with something wrong inside it: two choirs a half-step apart over a drone that never resolves.

sfx.name: machina-groan
sfx.about: Old machina under load: inharmonic metal bending slowly, with the structure creaking around it.

sfx.name: farplane-voices
sfx.about: Voices rising out of the Farplane: four entries at four distances, none of them together.

sfx.name: lenne-song
sfx.about: Lenne's phrase carried from somewhere else: the songstress hook, one voice, no accompaniment but air.

sfx.name: whistle-answer
sfx.about: A two-finger whistle, and after a long pause a fainter one answering from across the valley.

tracks.name: title
tracks.about: "Tide, Remembered" — FAREWELL bars 1-8 only on solo piano, the phrase never finishing, with HYMN_HEAD on flute at the very top; a story that is already over, being told anyway. A minor, 58 bpm.

tracks.name: battle-ffx
tracks.about: "Hold the Trail" — BATTLE_HOOK in full, with FATHER's rhythm (not its pitches) in the kit and bass; we can win this. E minor, 150 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-dread
tracks.about: "The Unsent Hymn" — HYMN in canon at the octave, choir over a pedal, SEYMOUR as a bass counter-line at half volume; something is watching, and it is patient. D minor, 90 bpm.

tracks.name: chapter-select
tracks.about: "Threshold, Unhurried" — HYMN_HEAD alone, four notes on flute, then FAREWELL_WALTZ bars 1-8 looping there; unhurried choosing; nothing here can hurt you yet. B minor, 84 bpm, 3/4.

tracks.name: pause
tracks.about: "Still Water" — HYMN bars 1-8, solo soprano over a tenor drone — no alto, no bass, no percussion; the game holding its breath. E Aeolian, 46 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-gagazet
tracks.about: "Where the Horns Fell Silent" — FATHER_STRAIGHTENED on one unaccompanied horn, once; FAREWELL_RISE on solo cello, once; then thirty seconds of drone; the mountain does not care. B minor, 72 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-seymour
tracks.about: "Noble Rot" — SEYMOUR in pedal organ and contrabasses, SEYMOUR_MIRROR in the manuals, the minor-third sequence, SEYMOUR_UNMOORED once in the final section; contempt that has convinced itself it is mercy. C# minor, 132 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-zanarkand-dome
tracks.about: "Where the Tide Stopped" — FAREWELL as a nocturne — melody up an octave, sextuplet left hand, soprano alone on bars 9-12 — and HYMN harmonised in strings, the only time it is ever warm; warmth remembered, which is worse than cold. B minor, 48 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yunalesca
tracks.about: "Rite Without End" — HYMN at +1, HYMN_HEAD as a four-entry canon three beats apart at the octave and the fourth with velocity locked at 0.62, then AMEN_PHRYGIAN; a rite that will finish with or without you. F Phrygian, 132 bpm, 6/8.

tracks.name: scene-dreams-end
tracks.about: "A City That Never Was" — FAREWELL_RISE alone on celesta, bent, over whole voicings planing in parallel with no functional logic; unmoored. no tonic, 76 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-jecht
tracks.about: "Blitz for Two" — FATHER in full; FAREWELL bars 9-12 at half-time in the bridge; the two superimposed in the climax, FATHER entering two beats late; two people talking over each other, and both of them are right. D minor, 144 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yu-yevon
tracks.about: "No End" — HYMN whole at augment(2), choir over one drone, bars 12-16 unaccompanied, the amen replaced by a held iv that never resolves and a second choir a fifth above, eight beats late; no end. E Aeolian, 40 bpm.

tracks.name: victory-ffx
tracks.about: "Bright After the Storm" — VICTORY_FANFARE as a one shot into VICTORY_LOOP, with FAREWELL's incipit in the major on flute at bars 7-8; the fanfare closes F-C, not G-C; relief, not triumph. C major, 120 bpm.

tracks.name: ending-ffx
tracks.about: "The Dream That Has To End" — FAREWELL complete twice — solo piano bars 1-8, then bars 1-16 on FAREWELL_CHORDS_RELEASED with full orchestra — and HYMN bars 13-16 with one Picardy third in the last bar; permission to stop. B minor → B major, 58 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-bevelle-underground
tracks.about: "Iron Undertow" — HYMN_POISONED once on low clarinet, and a SONGSTRESS_DARK fragment on synth bass; the machine under the cathedral. G minor, 100 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-farplane
tracks.about: "Where the Pyreflies Rest" — HYMN harmonised in quartal stacks, distant; FAREWELL_RISE answered by SONGSTRESS_RISE; rest without forgetting. E major, 92 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-vegnagun
tracks.about: "Iron Verdict" — SONGSTRESS_DARK mechanised: constant note lengths, jitter under 3 ms, bare octaves in low brass, the bridge stripped to a static pedal; something enormous, and nobody is driving. F minor, 168 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-shuyin
tracks.about: "The Weight of a Thousand Years" — SONGSTRESS in the parallel minor with the tonic unmoved, bar 7's borrowed joy gone merely diatonic; piano and strings, rubato in the half-time B; grief that has curdled. C# minor, 154 bpm.

tracks.name: victory-ffx2
tracks.about: "Sphere Shine" — SONGSTRESS_HOOK as a brass fanfare, the identity leap intact and major, then an 808 results groove on the hook; that was fun. Eb major, 128 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-ffx2-aeon
tracks.about: "Static Coronation" — SONGSTRESS_DARK as supersaw stabs over octave-pumping synth bass and breakbeats; the bridge keeps its ii-V; a pop star fighting a god, and enjoying it. Bb minor, 160 bpm.

tracks.name: ending-ffx2
tracks.about: "Wherever the Tide Takes Me" — SONGSTRESS complete with its bridge; the last chorus up a step, FAREWELL_RISE visiting on flute; the second game says goodbye more gently, because it can. Bb major → C, 84 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-fahrenheit
tracks.about: "Within the Hour" — FAREWELL_RISE and FAREWELL_FALL at double length on violins; the ship figure foreshadowed on flute; the peak closes on the AMEN; no time, and no way back. D minor, 104 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-evrae
tracks.about: "Open Sky, Closed Gate" — FAREWELL_RISE driven at speed as the head of a two-bar ship figure with rests in it; FAREWELL_RISE and FAREWELL_FALL at double length on a distant flute; no HYMN, no choir; the ship is the weapon; keep your distance. A minor, 144 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-seymour-macalania
tracks.about: "The Courtesy" — SEYMOUR an octave up on oboe over a harpsichord pavane that bows every fourth bar; SEYMOUR_MIRROR in the cellos; a chromatic decline that will not stop; the sequence takes one extra step at the summon, then a plagal amen to the wrong chord; polite, and wrong. C# minor, 126 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yojimbo
tracks.about: "The Summoner's Sorrow" — its own line (a rising fifth that leans on the flat sixth) on solo cello, then violin once a bowed pulse and taiko join; the line up the mode on a horn; one crack on the flat sixth, then control and the amen. No dominant anywhere; grief under control, and it cracks once. C minor, 132 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-macalania-temple
tracks.about: "The Frozen Temple" — no shared cell but HYMN_HEAD, once, at 1.5x on one distant voice as the door glows; quartal ice in high strings, irregular glockenspiel drips, an alto flute that walks through without a pulse and never lands on the tonic; harp open fifths on bVI - bVII - i. No dominant, no organ, no chanted choir; ice pretending to be masonry, and something behind the door. F# minor, 56 bpm.

sfx.name: cursor-move
sfx.about: Struck glass on the 5th, alone: 8 ms in, 45 ms of body, 300 ms of hall.

sfx.name: confirm
sfx.about: Glass and a bell partial rising a third, D to F#: two attacks, the second softer.

sfx.name: cancel
sfx.about: The confirm reversed and shorter: F# falling to D, damped early.

sfx.name: error
sfx.about: Denial: two soft bells a whole tone apart, the b6 leaning on the 5, damped in 200 ms.

sfx.name: menu-open
sfx.about: Harp harmonics over B D F# G, rolled upward in 120 ms, breath underneath.

sfx.name: menu-close
sfx.about: The same harp harmonics rolled back down, and the breath drawn in.

sfx.name: coin-tick
sfx.about: Results counter: one glockenspiel mote on the tonic, tiny and unhurried.

sfx.name: status-applied
sfx.about: A status lands: glass on the 2 — the ache — blooming into a vibraphone held note.

sfx.name: overdrive-full
sfx.about: The gauge fills: motes of light rising into a bell on the tonic inside a choir bloom.

sfx.name: sword-slash-1
sfx.about: Tidus: cloth, a fast blade passing left to right, and a bright steel ring behind it.

sfx.name: sword-slash-2
sfx.about: A heavier two-handed cut right to left: more cloth, a lower blade, a longer ring.

sfx.name: hit-1
sfx.about: A solid landed blow: cloth ahead of it, a drum body, sub weight on B1, a short steel edge.

sfx.name: hit-2
sfx.about: A glancing blow: the same gesture lighter, shorter and higher, with less floor under it.

sfx.name: critical
sfx.about: Critical: the impact, an orchestral stab on the tonic triad, and a tam-tam opening behind it.

sfx.name: ko-fall
sfx.about: A fighter goes down: the cello falls a whole tone, the body lands, the tam-tam mourns it.

sfx.name: footstep
sfx.about: One boot on stone: a small body thud under a scrape of grit, nothing above 9 kHz.

sfx.name: victory-fanfare
sfx.about: The victory sting: one long horn note that falls rather than rises, answered by a plagal chord — relief, not a trophy.

sfx.name: boss-roar
sfx.about: Something vast objects: low choir and basses under a rising snarl, with the floor moving.

sfx.name: machina-whir
sfx.about: Machina spinning up: a hollow drone climbing under metal ticks, then steam let go.

sfx.name: magic-charge
sfx.about: Gathering a spell: air pulled inward, the choir opening on the 2, glass motes collecting.

sfx.name: fire
sfx.about: Fire: a low roar of air with crackle riding on it, and the choir darkening underneath.

sfx.name: ice
sfx.about: Ice: glass shards over a freezing shimmer, brittle at the top and hollow underneath.

sfx.name: thunder
sfx.about: Thunder: a hard crack, a short metallic arc, and the room rolling away underneath it.

sfx.name: water
sfx.about: Water: a surge swelling in and falling back, with droplets scattering across the field.

sfx.name: holy
sfx.about: Holy: a bell struck inside an open choir chord, with the hall left to answer it.

sfx.name: cure
sfx.about: Cure: the choir blooms from the b6 up to the tonic while celesta motes rise through it.

sfx.name: summon
sfx.about: An aeon arrives: air drawn in, the floor giving way, and the full choir opening over a bell.

sfx.name: pyrefly
sfx.about: Pyreflies drifting up: weightless glass motes and breath, and nothing underneath them at all.

sfx.name: slash-light
sfx.about: Tidus: a quick single-handed cut — light cloth, fast air, a bright edge on the 5.

sfx.name: slash-heavy
sfx.about: Auron's katana: a slow heavy cleave, a low body, and steel that keeps ringing after it lands.

sfx.name: pierce
sfx.about: Kimahri's spear: a narrow whoosh that stays in one place, then a hard tip and a thin ring.

sfx.name: ball-hit
sfx.about: Wakka's blitzball: leather and air, a rubbery thump with no metal anywhere in it.

sfx.name: claw
sfx.about: Rikku's claw: three quick scratches across the field, each smaller than the last.

sfx.name: dagger-flurry
sfx.about: A flurry of small blades: four bright cuts in 300 ms, panned apart, one ring to close it.

sfx.name: gunshot
sfx.about: Yuna's pistol: a short dry crack with a low thump under it, gone in a quarter second.

sfx.name: gun-burst
sfx.about: Five rounds: the same crack five times, each a shade quieter, the room answering after.

sfx.name: whiff
sfx.about: A swing that hits nothing: cloth and air, and then the discomfort of no impact at all.

sfx.name: guard
sfx.about: A block: steel meeting steel, bright and short, with the shield ringing on after.

sfx.name: counter
sfx.about: A parry and the answer: a pizzicato tick, then a blade already on its way back.

sfx.name: breath-attack
sfx.about: An elemental breath: a long roar of air over low choir, with the room shaking under it.

sfx.name: laser-charge
sfx.about: Vegnagun taking aim: a hollow tone climbing a minor third while air is pulled toward it.

sfx.name: laser-fire
sfx.about: The beam: a held column of filtered air with a hard front edge and a hollow core.

sfx.name: explosion
sfx.about: A real explosion: the crack, the weight, and debris still settling a second later.

sfx.name: quake
sfx.about: The ground fails: a long low rumble with the timpani rolling and rock falling through it.

sfx.name: whip
sfx.about: A tentacle lash: air narrowing to a point, a crack, and wet weight behind it.

sfx.name: dissolve-pyreflies
sfx.about: An enemy comes apart into light: the body lets go, and what is left rises and is beautiful.

sfx.name: machina-destroy
sfx.about: Machina killed: metal tears, sparks scatter, and the drone it was running on dies away.

sfx.name: boss-phase-shift
sfx.about: A boss becomes something else: strings rise on the b6, the tam-tam opens, and it lands.

sfx.name: boss-overdrive-warning
sfx.about: Something terrible is being charged: a tremolo climb under an accelerating bell, no resolution.

sfx.name: petrify-shatter
sfx.about: Stone closing over, then breaking: a granular crackle that tightens, and glass giving way.

sfx.name: ctb-tick
sfx.about: The turn list advances: the quietest sound in the game, one glass mote on the 5.

sfx.name: ctb-shift
sfx.about: The order changes: two soft motes stepping down, neutral then home.

sfx.name: turn-ready
sfx.about: Your move: a small bell on the tonic with a harp note under it — an invitation, not an alarm.

sfx.name: menu-page
sfx.about: A tab turns: glass on the 2, with a breath of paper movement behind it.

sfx.name: battle-start
sfx.about: The encounter closes in: glass shatters upward, air sweeps past, and the strings land on the b6.

sfx.name: escape
sfx.about: Running: cloth, a falling whoosh away from the listener, and footfalls getting smaller.

sfx.name: od-cursor-tick
sfx.about: Swordplay cursor: a dry glass tick built to be retriggered ten times a second without fatigue.

sfx.name: od-timer-tick
sfx.about: The countdown: the same tick with the 2 under it, so it reads as a question running out.

sfx.name: od-hit-zone
sfx.about: Dead centre: glass rising a fourth into a bell — the sound of getting it exactly right.

sfx.name: od-miss
sfx.about: Missed the window: a damped low glass note that does not ring — disappointment, not punishment.

sfx.name: od-input
sfx.about: A Bushido button press: pizzicato with a mote of glass on top, tight and rhythmic.

sfx.name: od-sequence-complete
sfx.about: The sequence lands: a harp run up the tonic triad into a bell and a breath of choir.

sfx.name: od-reel-spin
sfx.about: Reels spinning: a light wooden clatter, deliberately dry so a fast retrigger does not smear.

sfx.name: od-reel-stop
sfx.about: A reel lands: one wooden clunk with a small body and no ring at all.

sfx.name: od-fury-rotation
sfx.about: Lulu's rotation counter: a glass tick with a rising breath, so speed reads as lift.

sfx.name: od-mix-select
sfx.about: Rikku picks an ingredient: a small glass bottle note on the 2, close and dry.

sfx.name: od-success
sfx.about: The minigame went well: a short harp lift into the tonic, warm and over quickly.

sfx.name: od-fail
sfx.about: The minigame went badly: the b6 leaning on the 5 in low glass, damped, no second strike.

sfx.name: chain-hit
sfx.about: FFX-2 chain hit: one bright glass note the caller steps upward per link in the chain.

sfx.name: chain-break
sfx.about: The chain ends: the glass falls to the 2 and a breath closes over it.

sfx.name: spherechange
sfx.about: A dressphere change: light spins up, glass scatters outward, and the tonic chord blooms.

sfx.name: garment-grid-gate
sfx.about: A gate bonus: two glass notes a fourth apart and a soprano breath over the top.

sfx.name: fire-2

sfx.name: fire-3
sfx.about: Firaga: a sub-bass whoomp opens the ground, two firestorm waves roll through, the choir sears above.

sfx.name: ice-3

sfx.name: lightning

sfx.name: lightning-2
sfx.about: Thundara: two cracks half a beat apart, a longer arc, and heavier weather behind them.

sfx.name: lightning-3
sfx.about: Thundaga: three strikes, a roaring arc, and a storm rolling out across the whole hall.

sfx.name: water-3

sfx.name: haste
sfx.about: Haste: glass ticks accelerating up the triad until they blur into one shimmer.

sfx.name: slow
sfx.about: Slow: the same ticks decelerating and sagging — the tape losing speed rather than a pitch bend.

sfx.name: stop
sfx.about: Stop: a tick that is cut off mid-ring, and a frozen shimmer standing where it was.

sfx.name: sleep
sfx.about: Sleep: three drowsy notes falling a step at a time, the last one barely arriving.

sfx.name: silence
sfx.about: Silence: everything is pulled inward and the room is shut — a reversed swell into no tail at all.

sfx.name: blind
sfx.about: Blind: a dark smoky pass across the eyes, low and soft, with the light going out of the top.

sfx.name: poison
sfx.about: Poison: a sickly held note wobbling a quarter-tone under the 2, with slow bubbles in it.

sfx.name: berserk
sfx.about: Berserk: low brass and strings surge up together and refuse to resolve.

sfx.name: confuse
sfx.about: Confuse: one glass figure spiralling through the pitch set, never landing where it should.

sfx.name: curse
sfx.about: Curse: the b6 and the 2 struck together low and left to grind — the one deliberate dissonance.

sfx.name: scan
sfx.about: Scan: a thin sweep with three small readings taken along it, clinical and quiet.

sfx.name: steal-success
sfx.about: Steal: a quick grab of cloth and a bright little jingle getting away with it.

sfx.name: steal-fail
sfx.about: Nothing in the hand: the same grab, then a dull pizzicato thud where the jingle should be.

sfx.name: item-use
sfx.about: An item: a cork, a small glass bottle, and one mote of light leaving it.

sfx.name: phoenix-down
sfx.about: Phoenix Down: a feather turning over in the air, then warmth arriving underneath it.

sfx.name: elixir
sfx.about: Elixir: everything a cure does, unhurried, with the bells allowed to ring all the way out.

sfx.name: mp-restore
sfx.about: MP comes back: a cool blue shimmer filling from the bottom of the triad upward.

sfx.name: buff-generic
sfx.about: Something good lands: two glass notes rising to the tonic over a warm chord. Always upward.

sfx.name: debuff-generic
sfx.about: Something bad lands: two glass notes falling to the b6 over low strings. Always downward, never harsh.

sfx.name: summon-depart
sfx.about: The aeon leaves: the arrival played backwards — weight lifting, light going up and away.

sfx.name: aeon-overdrive
sfx.about: An aeon's Overdrive: a long charge under a tremolo climb, then the choir arriving with the whole orchestra.

sfx.name: wind-high-altitude
sfx.about: Summit wind: a cold low bed with one thin keening line drifting slowly across it.

sfx.name: wind-gust
sfx.about: One gust: it arrives, whistles past from left to right, and takes the top of the field with it.

sfx.name: kimahri-roar
sfx.about: A Ronso cries out in grief, not threat: a torn falling line over breath, and it breaks at the end.

sfx.name: fayth-hum
sfx.about: The fayth: the hymn's four-note head sung wordlessly, harmonised underneath, hanging in the air.

sfx.name: dome-echo
sfx.about: One sound in a stone hall: a struck bell answered three times, each answer darker and further away.

sfx.name: yu-yevon-chant
sfx.about: A chant with something wrong inside it: two choirs a half-step apart over a drone that never resolves.

sfx.name: machina-groan
sfx.about: Old machina under load: inharmonic metal bending slowly, with the structure creaking around it.

sfx.name: farplane-voices
sfx.about: Voices rising out of the Farplane: four entries at four distances, none of them together.

sfx.name: lenne-song
sfx.about: Lenne's phrase carried from somewhere else: the songstress hook, one voice, no accompaniment but air.

sfx.name: whistle-answer
sfx.about: A two-finger whistle, and after a long pause a fainter one answering from across the valley.

tracks.name: title
tracks.about: "Tide, Remembered" — FAREWELL bars 1-8 only on solo piano, the phrase never finishing, with HYMN_HEAD on flute at the very top; a story that is already over, being told anyway. A minor, 58 bpm.

tracks.name: battle-ffx
tracks.about: "Hold the Trail" — BATTLE_HOOK in full, with FATHER's rhythm (not its pitches) in the kit and bass; we can win this. E minor, 150 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-dread
tracks.about: "The Unsent Hymn" — HYMN in canon at the octave, choir over a pedal, SEYMOUR as a bass counter-line at half volume; something is watching, and it is patient. D minor, 90 bpm.

tracks.name: chapter-select
tracks.about: "Threshold, Unhurried" — HYMN_HEAD alone, four notes on flute, then FAREWELL_WALTZ bars 1-8 looping there; unhurried choosing; nothing here can hurt you yet. B minor, 84 bpm, 3/4.

tracks.name: pause
tracks.about: "Still Water" — HYMN bars 1-8, solo soprano over a tenor drone — no alto, no bass, no percussion; the game holding its breath. E Aeolian, 46 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-gagazet
tracks.about: "Where the Horns Fell Silent" — FATHER_STRAIGHTENED on one unaccompanied horn, once; FAREWELL_RISE on solo cello, once; then thirty seconds of drone; the mountain does not care. B minor, 72 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-seymour
tracks.about: "Noble Rot" — SEYMOUR in pedal organ and contrabasses, SEYMOUR_MIRROR in the manuals, the minor-third sequence, SEYMOUR_UNMOORED once in the final section; contempt that has convinced itself it is mercy. C# minor, 132 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-zanarkand-dome
tracks.about: "Where the Tide Stopped" — FAREWELL as a nocturne — melody up an octave, sextuplet left hand, soprano alone on bars 9-12 — and HYMN harmonised in strings, the only time it is ever warm; warmth remembered, which is worse than cold. B minor, 48 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yunalesca
tracks.about: "Rite Without End" — HYMN at +1, HYMN_HEAD as a four-entry canon three beats apart at the octave and the fourth with velocity locked at 0.62, then AMEN_PHRYGIAN; a rite that will finish with or without you. F Phrygian, 132 bpm, 6/8.

tracks.name: scene-dreams-end
tracks.about: "A City That Never Was" — FAREWELL_RISE alone on celesta, bent, over whole voicings planing in parallel with no functional logic; unmoored. no tonic, 76 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-jecht
tracks.about: "Blitz for Two" — FATHER in full; FAREWELL bars 9-12 at half-time in the bridge; the two superimposed in the climax, FATHER entering two beats late; two people talking over each other, and both of them are right. D minor, 144 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yu-yevon
tracks.about: "No End" — HYMN whole at augment(2), choir over one drone, bars 12-16 unaccompanied, the amen replaced by a held iv that never resolves and a second choir a fifth above, eight beats late; no end. E Aeolian, 40 bpm.

tracks.name: victory-ffx
tracks.about: "Bright After the Storm" — VICTORY_FANFARE as a one shot into VICTORY_LOOP, with FAREWELL's incipit in the major on flute at bars 7-8; the fanfare closes F-C, not G-C; relief, not triumph. C major, 120 bpm.

tracks.name: ending-ffx
tracks.about: "The Dream That Has To End" — FAREWELL complete twice — solo piano bars 1-8, then bars 1-16 on FAREWELL_CHORDS_RELEASED with full orchestra — and HYMN bars 13-16 with one Picardy third in the last bar; permission to stop. B minor → B major, 58 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-bevelle-underground
tracks.about: "Iron Undertow" — HYMN_POISONED once on low clarinet, and a SONGSTRESS_DARK fragment on synth bass; the machine under the cathedral. G minor, 100 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-farplane
tracks.about: "Where the Pyreflies Rest" — HYMN harmonised in quartal stacks, distant; FAREWELL_RISE answered by SONGSTRESS_RISE; rest without forgetting. E major, 92 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-vegnagun
tracks.about: "Iron Verdict" — SONGSTRESS_DARK mechanised: constant note lengths, jitter under 3 ms, bare octaves in low brass, the bridge stripped to a static pedal; something enormous, and nobody is driving. F minor, 168 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-shuyin
tracks.about: "The Weight of a Thousand Years" — SONGSTRESS in the parallel minor with the tonic unmoved, bar 7's borrowed joy gone merely diatonic; piano and strings, rubato in the half-time B; grief that has curdled. C# minor, 154 bpm.

tracks.name: victory-ffx2
tracks.about: "Sphere Shine" — SONGSTRESS_HOOK as a brass fanfare, the identity leap intact and major, then an 808 results groove on the hook; that was fun. Eb major, 128 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-ffx2-aeon
tracks.about: "Static Coronation" — SONGSTRESS_DARK as supersaw stabs over octave-pumping synth bass and breakbeats; the bridge keeps its ii-V; a pop star fighting a god, and enjoying it. Bb minor, 160 bpm.

tracks.name: ending-ffx2
tracks.about: "Wherever the Tide Takes Me" — SONGSTRESS complete with its bridge; the last chorus up a step, FAREWELL_RISE visiting on flute; the second game says goodbye more gently, because it can. Bb major → C, 84 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-fahrenheit
tracks.about: "Within the Hour" — FAREWELL_RISE and FAREWELL_FALL at double length on violins; the ship figure foreshadowed on flute; the peak closes on the AMEN; no time, and no way back. D minor, 104 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-evrae
tracks.about: "Open Sky, Closed Gate" — FAREWELL_RISE driven at speed as the head of a two-bar ship figure with rests in it; FAREWELL_RISE and FAREWELL_FALL at double length on a distant flute; no HYMN, no choir; the ship is the weapon; keep your distance. A minor, 144 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-seymour-macalania
tracks.about: "The Courtesy" — SEYMOUR an octave up on oboe over a harpsichord pavane that bows every fourth bar; SEYMOUR_MIRROR in the cellos; a chromatic decline that will not stop; the sequence takes one extra step at the summon, then a plagal amen to the wrong chord; polite, and wrong. C# minor, 126 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yojimbo
tracks.about: "The Summoner's Sorrow" — its own line (a rising fifth that leans on the flat sixth) on solo cello, then violin once a bowed pulse and taiko join; the line up the mode on a horn; one crack on the flat sixth, then control and the amen. No dominant anywhere; grief under control, and it cracks once. C minor, 132 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-macalania-temple
tracks.about: "The Frozen Temple" — no shared cell but HYMN_HEAD, once, at 1.5x on one distant voice as the door glows; quartal ice in high strings, irregular glockenspiel drips, an alto flute that walks through without a pulse and never lands on the tonic; harp open fifths on bVI - bVII - i. No dominant, no organ, no chanted choir; ice pretending to be masonry, and something behind the door. F# minor, 56 bpm.

sfx.name: overdrive-full

sfx.name: sword-slash-2
sfx.about: A heavier two-handed cut right to left: more cloth, a lower blade, a longer ring.

sfx.name: hit-2
sfx.about: A glancing blow: the same gesture lighter, shorter and higher, with less floor under it.

sfx.name: critical

sfx.name: ko-fall

sfx.name: footstep

sfx.name: victory-fanfare

sfx.name: boss-roar

sfx.name: machina-whir

sfx.name: magic-charge
sfx.about: Gathering a spell: air pulled inward, the choir opening on the 2, glass motes collecting.

sfx.name: fire

sfx.name: ice

sfx.name: thunder

sfx.name: water
sfx.about: Water: a surge swelling in and falling back, with droplets scattering across the field.

sfx.name: holy
sfx.about: Holy: a bell struck inside an open choir chord, with the hall left to answer it.

sfx.name: cure
sfx.about: Cure: the choir blooms from the b6 up to the tonic while celesta motes rise through it.

sfx.name: summon
sfx.about: An aeon arrives: air drawn in, the floor giving way, and the full choir opening over a bell.

sfx.name: pyrefly
sfx.about: Pyreflies drifting up: weightless glass motes and breath, and nothing underneath them at all.

sfx.name: slash-light
sfx.about: Tidus: a quick single-handed cut — light cloth, fast air, a bright edge on the 5.

sfx.name: slash-heavy
sfx.about: Auron's katana: a slow heavy cleave, a low body, and steel that keeps ringing after it lands.

sfx.name: pierce
sfx.about: Kimahri's spear: a narrow whoosh that stays in one place, then a hard tip and a thin ring.

sfx.name: ball-hit
sfx.about: Wakka's blitzball: leather and air, a rubbery thump with no metal anywhere in it.

sfx.name: claw
sfx.about: Rikku's claw: three quick scratches across the field, each smaller than the last.

sfx.name: dagger-flurry
sfx.about: A flurry of small blades: four bright cuts in 300 ms, panned apart, one ring to close it.

sfx.name: gunshot
sfx.about: Yuna's pistol: a short dry crack with a low thump under it, gone in a quarter second.

sfx.name: gun-burst
sfx.about: Five rounds: the same crack five times, each a shade quieter, the room answering after.

sfx.name: whiff
sfx.about: A swing that hits nothing: cloth and air, and then the discomfort of no impact at all.

sfx.name: guard
sfx.about: A block: steel meeting steel, bright and short, with the shield ringing on after.

sfx.name: counter
sfx.about: A parry and the answer: a pizzicato tick, then a blade already on its way back.

sfx.name: breath-attack
sfx.about: An elemental breath: a long roar of air over low choir, with the room shaking under it.

sfx.name: laser-charge
sfx.about: Vegnagun taking aim: a hollow tone climbing a minor third while air is pulled toward it.

sfx.name: laser-fire
sfx.about: The beam: a held column of filtered air with a hard front edge and a hollow core.

sfx.name: explosion
sfx.about: A real explosion: the crack, the weight, and debris still settling a second later.

sfx.name: quake
sfx.about: The ground fails: a long low rumble with the timpani rolling and rock falling through it.

sfx.name: whip
sfx.about: A tentacle lash: air narrowing to a point, a crack, and wet weight behind it.

sfx.name: dissolve-pyreflies
sfx.about: An enemy comes apart into light: the body lets go, and what is left rises and is beautiful.

sfx.name: machina-destroy
sfx.about: Machina killed: metal tears, sparks scatter, and the drone it was running on dies away.

sfx.name: boss-phase-shift
sfx.about: A boss becomes something else: strings rise on the b6, the tam-tam opens, and it lands.

sfx.name: boss-overdrive-warning
sfx.about: Something terrible is being charged: a tremolo climb under an accelerating bell, no resolution.

sfx.name: petrify-shatter
sfx.about: Stone closing over, then breaking: a granular crackle that tightens, and glass giving way.

sfx.name: ctb-tick
sfx.about: The turn list advances: the quietest sound in the game, one glass mote on the 5.

sfx.name: ctb-shift
sfx.about: The order changes: two soft motes stepping down, neutral then home.

sfx.name: turn-ready
sfx.about: Your move: a small bell on the tonic with a harp note under it — an invitation, not an alarm.

sfx.name: menu-page
sfx.about: A tab turns: glass on the 2, with a breath of paper movement behind it.

sfx.name: battle-start
sfx.about: The encounter closes in: glass shatters upward, air sweeps past, and the strings land on the b6.

sfx.name: escape
sfx.about: Running: cloth, a falling whoosh away from the listener, and footfalls getting smaller.

sfx.name: od-cursor-tick
sfx.about: Swordplay cursor: a dry glass tick built to be retriggered ten times a second without fatigue.

sfx.name: od-timer-tick
sfx.about: The countdown: the same tick with the 2 under it, so it reads as a question running out.

sfx.name: od-hit-zone
sfx.about: Dead centre: glass rising a fourth into a bell — the sound of getting it exactly right.

sfx.name: od-miss

sfx.name: od-input
sfx.about: A Bushido button press: pizzicato with a mote of glass on top, tight and rhythmic.

sfx.name: od-sequence-complete

sfx.name: od-reel-spin

sfx.name: od-reel-stop

sfx.name: od-fury-rotation

sfx.name: od-mix-select

sfx.name: od-success

sfx.about: A Ronso cries out in grief, not threat: a torn falling line over breath, and it breaks at the end.

sfx.name: fayth-hum
sfx.about: The fayth: the hymn's four-note head sung wordlessly, harmonised underneath, hanging in the air.

sfx.name: dome-echo
sfx.about: One sound in a stone hall: a struck bell answered three times, each answer darker and further away.

sfx.name: yu-yevon-chant
sfx.about: A chant with something wrong inside it: two choirs a half-step apart over a drone that never resolves.

sfx.name: machina-groan
sfx.about: Old machina under load: inharmonic metal bending slowly, with the structure creaking around it.

sfx.name: farplane-voices
sfx.about: Voices rising out of the Farplane: four entries at four distances, none of them together.

sfx.name: lenne-song
sfx.about: Lenne's phrase carried from somewhere else: the songstress hook, one voice, no accompaniment but air.

sfx.name: whistle-answer
sfx.about: A two-finger whistle, and after a long pause a fainter one answering from across the valley.

tracks.name: title
tracks.about: "Tide, Remembered" — FAREWELL bars 1-8 only on solo piano, the phrase never finishing, with HYMN_HEAD on flute at the very top; a story that is already over, being told anyway. A minor, 58 bpm.

tracks.name: battle-ffx
tracks.about: "Hold the Trail" — BATTLE_HOOK in full, with FATHER's rhythm (not its pitches) in the kit and bass; we can win this. E minor, 150 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-dread
tracks.about: "The Unsent Hymn" — HYMN in canon at the octave, choir over a pedal, SEYMOUR as a bass counter-line at half volume; something is watching, and it is patient. D minor, 90 bpm.

tracks.name: chapter-select
tracks.about: "Threshold, Unhurried" — HYMN_HEAD alone, four notes on flute, then FAREWELL_WALTZ bars 1-8 looping there; unhurried choosing; nothing here can hurt you yet. B minor, 84 bpm, 3/4.

tracks.name: pause
tracks.about: "Still Water" — HYMN bars 1-8, solo soprano over a tenor drone — no alto, no bass, no percussion; the game holding its breath. E Aeolian, 46 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-gagazet
tracks.about: "Where the Horns Fell Silent" — FATHER_STRAIGHTENED on one unaccompanied horn, once; FAREWELL_RISE on solo cello, once; then thirty seconds of drone; the mountain does not care. B minor, 72 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-seymour
tracks.about: "Noble Rot" — SEYMOUR in pedal organ and contrabasses, SEYMOUR_MIRROR in the manuals, the minor-third sequence, SEYMOUR_UNMOORED once in the final section; contempt that has convinced itself it is mercy. C# minor, 132 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-zanarkand-dome
tracks.about: "Where the Tide Stopped" — FAREWELL as a nocturne — melody up an octave, sextuplet left hand, soprano alone on bars 9-12 — and HYMN harmonised in strings, the only time it is ever warm; warmth remembered, which is worse than cold. B minor, 48 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yunalesca
tracks.about: "Rite Without End" — HYMN at +1, HYMN_HEAD as a four-entry canon three beats apart at the octave and the fourth with velocity locked at 0.62, then AMEN_PHRYGIAN; a rite that will finish with or without you. F Phrygian, 132 bpm, 6/8.

tracks.name: scene-dreams-end
tracks.about: "A City That Never Was" — FAREWELL_RISE alone on celesta, bent, over whole voicings planing in parallel with no functional logic; unmoored. no tonic, 76 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-jecht
tracks.about: "Blitz for Two" — FATHER in full; FAREWELL bars 9-12 at half-time in the bridge; the two superimposed in the climax, FATHER entering two beats late; two people talking over each other, and both of them are right. D minor, 144 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yu-yevon
tracks.about: "No End" — HYMN whole at augment(2), choir over one drone, bars 12-16 unaccompanied, the amen replaced by a held iv that never resolves and a second choir a fifth above, eight beats late; no end. E Aeolian, 40 bpm.

tracks.name: victory-ffx
tracks.about: "Bright After the Storm" — VICTORY_FANFARE as a one shot into VICTORY_LOOP, with FAREWELL's incipit in the major on flute at bars 7-8; the fanfare closes F-C, not G-C; relief, not triumph. C major, 120 bpm.

tracks.name: ending-ffx
tracks.about: "The Dream That Has To End" — FAREWELL complete twice — solo piano bars 1-8, then bars 1-16 on FAREWELL_CHORDS_RELEASED with full orchestra — and HYMN bars 13-16 with one Picardy third in the last bar; permission to stop. B minor → B major, 58 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-bevelle-underground
tracks.about: "Iron Undertow" — HYMN_POISONED once on low clarinet, and a SONGSTRESS_DARK fragment on synth bass; the machine under the cathedral. G minor, 100 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-farplane
tracks.about: "Where the Pyreflies Rest" — HYMN harmonised in quartal stacks, distant; FAREWELL_RISE answered by SONGSTRESS_RISE; rest without forgetting. E major, 92 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-vegnagun
tracks.about: "Iron Verdict" — SONGSTRESS_DARK mechanised: constant note lengths, jitter under 3 ms, bare octaves in low brass, the bridge stripped to a static pedal; something enormous, and nobody is driving. F minor, 168 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-shuyin
tracks.about: "The Weight of a Thousand Years" — SONGSTRESS in the parallel minor with the tonic unmoved, bar 7's borrowed joy gone merely diatonic; piano and strings, rubato in the half-time B; grief that has curdled. C# minor, 154 bpm.

tracks.name: victory-ffx2
tracks.about: "Sphere Shine" — SONGSTRESS_HOOK as a brass fanfare, the identity leap intact and major, then an 808 results groove on the hook; that was fun. Eb major, 128 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-ffx2-aeon
tracks.about: "Static Coronation" — SONGSTRESS_DARK as supersaw stabs over octave-pumping synth bass and breakbeats; the bridge keeps its ii-V; a pop star fighting a god, and enjoying it. Bb minor, 160 bpm.

tracks.name: ending-ffx2
tracks.about: "Wherever the Tide Takes Me" — SONGSTRESS complete with its bridge; the last chorus up a step, FAREWELL_RISE visiting on flute; the second game says goodbye more gently, because it can. Bb major → C, 84 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-fahrenheit
tracks.about: "Within the Hour" — FAREWELL_RISE and FAREWELL_FALL at double length on violins; the ship figure foreshadowed on flute; the peak closes on the AMEN; no time, and no way back. D minor, 104 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-evrae
tracks.about: "Open Sky, Closed Gate" — FAREWELL_RISE driven at speed as the head of a two-bar ship figure with rests in it; FAREWELL_RISE and FAREWELL_FALL at double length on a distant flute; no HYMN, no choir; the ship is the weapon; keep your distance. A minor, 144 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-seymour-macalania
tracks.about: "The Courtesy" — SEYMOUR an octave up on oboe over a harpsichord pavane that bows every fourth bar; SEYMOUR_MIRROR in the cellos; a chromatic decline that will not stop; the sequence takes one extra step at the summon, then a plagal amen to the wrong chord; polite, and wrong. C# minor, 126 bpm.

tracks.name: boss-yojimbo
tracks.about: "The Summoner's Sorrow" — its own line (a rising fifth that leans on the flat sixth) on solo cello, then violin once a bowed pulse and taiko join; the line up the mode on a horn; one crack on the flat sixth, then control and the amen. No dominant anywhere; grief under control, and it cracks once. C minor, 132 bpm.

tracks.name: scene-macalania-temple
tracks.about: "The Frozen Temple" — no shared cell but HYMN_HEAD, once, at 1.5x on one distant voice as the door glows; quartal ice in high strings, irregular glockenspiel drips, an alto flute that walks through without a pulse and never lands on the tonic; harp open fifths on bVI - bVII - i. No dominant, no organ, no chanted choir; ice pretending to be masonry, and something behind the door. F# minor, 56 bpm.

sfx.name: cursor-move
sfx.about: Struck glass on the 5th, alone: 8 ms in, 45 ms of body, 300 ms of hall.

sfx.name: confirm
sfx.about: Glass and a bell partial rising a third, D to F#: two attacks, the second softer.

sfx.name: cancel
sfx.about: The confirm reversed and shorter: F# falling to D, damped early.

sfx.name: error
sfx.about: Denial: two soft bells a whole tone apart, the b6 leaning on the 5, damped in 200 ms.

sfx.name: menu-open
sfx.about: Harp harmonics over B D F# G, rolled upward in 120 ms, breath underneath.

sfx.name: menu-close
sfx.about: The same harp harmonics rolled back down, and the breath drawn in.

sfx.name: coin-tick
sfx.about: Results counter: one glockenspiel mote on the tonic, tiny and unhurried.

sfx.name: status-applied
sfx.about: A status lands: glass on the 2 — the ache — blooming into a vibraphone held note.

sfx.name: overdrive-full
sfx.about: The gauge fills: motes of light rising into a bell on the tonic inside a choir bloom.

sfx.name: sword-slash-1
sfx.about: Tidus: cloth, a fast blade passing left to right, and a bright steel ring behind it.

sfx.name: sword-slash-2
sfx.about: A heavier two-handed cut right to left: more cloth, a lower blade, a longer ring.

sfx.name: hit-1
sfx.about: A solid landed blow: cloth ahead of it, a drum body, sub weight on B1, a short steel edge.

sfx.name: hit-2
sfx.about: A glancing blow: the same gesture lighter, shorter and higher, with less floor under it.

sfx.name: critical
sfx.about: Critical: the impact, an orchestral stab on the tonic triad, and a tam-tam opening behind it.

sfx.name: ko-fall
sfx.about: A fighter goes down: the cello falls a whole tone, the body lands, the tam-tam mourns it.

sfx.name: footstep
sfx.about: One boot on stone: a small body thud under a scrape of grit, nothing above 9 kHz.

sfx.name: victory-fanfare
sfx.about: The victory sting: one long horn note that falls rather than rises, answered by a plagal chord — relief, not a trophy.

sfx.name: boss-roar
sfx.about: Something vast objects: low choir and basses under a rising snarl, with the floor moving.

sfx.name: machina-whir
sfx.about: Machina spinning up: a hollow drone climbing under metal ticks, then steam let go.

sfx.name: magic-charge
sfx.about: Gathering a spell: air pulled inward, the choir opening on the 2, glass motes collecting.

sfx.name: fire
sfx.about: Fire: a low roar of air with crackle riding on it, and the choir darkening underneath.

sfx.name: ice
sfx.about: Ice: glass shards over a freezing shimmer, brittle at the top and hollow underneath.

sfx.name: thunder
sfx.about: Thunder: a hard crack, a short metallic arc, and the room rolling away underneath it.

sfx.name: water
sfx.about: Water: a surge swelling in and falling back, with droplets scattering across the field.

sfx.name: holy
sfx.about: Holy: a bell struck inside an open choir chord, with the hall left to answer it.

sfx.name: cure
sfx.about: Cure: the choir blooms from the b6 up to the tonic while celesta motes rise through it.

sfx.name: summon
sfx.about: An aeon arrives: air drawn in, the floor giving way, and the full choir opening over a bell.

sfx.name: pyrefly
sfx.about: Pyreflies drifting up: weightless glass motes and breath, and nothing underneath them at all.

sfx.name: slash-light
sfx.about: Tidus: a quick single-handed cut — light cloth, fast air, a bright edge on the 5.

sfx.name: slash-heavy
sfx.about: Auron's katana: a slow heavy cleave, a low body, and steel that keeps ringing after it lands.

sfx.name: pierce
sfx.about: Kimahri's spear: a narrow whoosh that stays in one place, then a hard tip and a thin ring.

sfx.name: ball-hit
sfx.about: Wakka's blitzball: leather and air, a rubbery thump with no metal anywhere in it.

sfx.name: claw
sfx.about: Rikku's claw: three quick scratches across the field, each smaller than the last.

sfx.name: dagger-flurry
sfx.about: A flurry of small blades: four bright cuts in 300 ms, panned apart, one ring to close it.

sfx.name: gunshot
sfx.about: Yuna's pistol: a short dry crack with a low thump under it, gone in a quarter second.

sfx.name: gun-burst
sfx.about: Five rounds: the same crack five times, each a shade quieter, the room answering after.

sfx.name: whiff
sfx.about: A swing that hits nothing: cloth and air, and then the discomfort of no impact at all.

sfx.name: guard
sfx.about: A block: steel meeting steel, bright and short, with the shield ringing on after.

sfx.name: counter
sfx.about: A parry and the answer: a pizzicato tick, then a blade already on its way back.

sfx.name: breath-attack
sfx.about: An elemental breath: a long roar of air over low choir, with the room shaking under it.

sfx.name: laser-charge
sfx.about: Vegnagun taking aim: a hollow tone climbing a minor third while air is pulled toward it.

sfx.name: laser-fire
sfx.about: The beam: a held column of filtered air with a hard front edge and a hollow core.

sfx.name: explosion
sfx.about: A real explosion: the crack, the weight, and debris still settling a second later.

sfx.name: quake
sfx.about: The ground fails: a long low rumble with the timpani rolling and rock falling through it.

sfx.name: whip
sfx.about: A tentacle lash: air narrowing to a point, a crack, and wet weight behind it.

sfx.name: dissolve-pyreflies
sfx.about: An enemy comes apart into light: the body lets go, and what is left rises and is beautiful.

sfx.name: machina-destroy
sfx.about: Machina killed: metal tears, sparks scatter, and the drone it was running on dies away.

sfx.name: boss-phase-shift
sfx.about: A boss becomes something else: strings rise on the b6, the tam-tam opens, and it lands.

sfx.name: boss-overdrive-warning
sfx.about: Something terrible is being charged: a tremolo climb under an accelerating bell, no resolution.

sfx.name: petrify-shatter
sfx.about: Stone closing over, then breaking: a granular crackle that tightens, and glass giving way.

sfx.name: ctb-tick
sfx.about: The turn list advances: the quietest sound in the game, one glass mote on the 5.

sfx.name: ctb-shift
sfx.about: The order changes: two soft motes stepping down, neutral then home.

sfx.name: turn-ready
sfx.about: Your move: a small bell on the tonic with a harp note under it — an invitation, not an alarm.

sfx.name: menu-page
sfx.about: A tab turns: glass on the 2, with a breath of paper movement behind it.

sfx.name: battle-start
sfx.about: The encounter closes in: glass shatters upward, air sweeps past, and the strings land on the b6.

sfx.name: escape
sfx.about: Running: cloth, a falling whoosh away from the listener, and footfalls getting smaller.

sfx.name: od-cursor-tick
sfx.about: Swordplay cursor: a dry glass tick built to be retriggered ten times a second without fatigue.

sfx.name: od-timer-tick
sfx.about: The countdown: the same tick with the 2 under it, so it reads as a question running out.

sfx.name: od-hit-zone
sfx.about: Dead centre: glass rising a fourth into a bell — the sound of getting it exactly right.

sfx.name: od-miss
sfx.about: Missed the window: a damped low glass note that does not ring — disappointment, not punishment.

sfx.name: od-input
sfx.about: A Bushido button press: pizzicato with a mote of glass on top, tight and rhythmic.

sfx.name: od-sequence-complete
sfx.about: The sequence lands: a harp run up the tonic triad into a bell and a breath of choir.

sfx.name: od-reel-spin
sfx.about: Reels spinning: a light wooden clatter, deliberately dry so a fast retrigger does not smear.

sfx.name: od-reel-stop
sfx.about: A reel lands: one wooden clunk with a small body and no ring at all.

sfx.name: od-fury-rotation
sfx.about: Lulu's rotation counter: a glass tick with a rising breath, so speed reads as lift.

sfx.name: od-mix-select
sfx.about: Rikku picks an ingredient: a small glass bottle note on the 2, close and dry.

sfx.name: od-success
sfx.about: The minigame went well: a short harp lift into the tonic, warm and over quickly.

sfx.name: od-fail
sfx.about: The minigame went badly: the b6 leaning on the 5 in low glass, damped, no second strike.

sfx.name: chain-hit
sfx.about: FFX-2 chain hit: one bright glass note the caller steps upward per link in the chain.

sfx.name: chain-break
sfx.about: The chain ends: the glass falls to the 2 and a breath closes over it.

sfx.name: spherechange
sfx.about: A dressphere change: light spins up, glass scatters outward, and the tonic chord blooms.

sfx.name: garment-grid-gate
sfx.about: A gate bonus: two glass notes a fourth apart and a soprano breath over the top.

sfx.name: fire-2
sfx.about: Fira: two waves of flame overlapping, the second wider, with the choir low underneath.

sfx.name: fire-3
sfx.about: Firaga: a sub-bass whoomp opens the ground, two firestorm waves roll through, the choir sears above.

sfx.name: ice-2
sfx.about: Blizzara: a denser hail of glass with a longer freeze behind it and real cold underneath.

sfx.name: ice-3
sfx.about: Blizzaga: a glacier arrives — shard hail, a deep frozen impact, and a wide shimmer over the wreckage.

sfx.name: lightning
sfx.about: A bolt: one hard crack, a short arc, and a rumble that leaves the room ringing.

sfx.name: lightning-2
sfx.about: Thundara: two cracks half a beat apart, a longer arc, and heavier weather behind them.

sfx.name: lightning-3
sfx.about: Thundaga: three strikes, a roaring arc, and a storm rolling out across the whole hall.

sfx.name: water-2
sfx.about: Watera: two surges, the second breaking over the first, with spray between them.

sfx.name: water-3
sfx.about: Waterga: the tide comes in — a deep surge, twin swells, wide spray, and a crash that empties the room.

sfx.name: holy-2
sfx.about: Grand Holy: a peal of tubular bells inside a wide choir chord, with the soprano over the top.

sfx.name: gravity
sfx.about: Demi: space folding inward — a descending hollow tone and air dragged after it.

sfx.name: gravity-2
sfx.about: Demi at full weight: the same collapse, slower, ending on an impact that flattens the floor.

sfx.name: flare
sfx.about: Flare: everything collapses toward one point, holds for an instant, and detonates white-hot.

sfx.name: ultima
sfx.about: Ultima: a long gathering, a detonation that takes the room with it, and light still falling afterwards.

sfx.name: bio
sfx.about: Bio: something viscous, bubbling low in the field, with a sickly held note inside it.

sfx.name: death
sfx.about: Death: a cold choir breath falling away, one bell tolled underneath, and nothing else.

sfx.name: doom-tick
sfx.about: Doom: one small bell on the 2, struck as if by a clock, with the hall too quiet around it.

sfx.name: drain
sfx.about: Drain: air and choir pulled backwards out of the target and into the caster.

sfx.name: osmose
sfx.about: Osmose: the same siphon an octave up and made of glass — thin, cold and quick.

sfx.name: meteor
sfx.about: Meteor: three whistles falling out of the sky at different distances, and three impacts under them.

sfx.name: cure-2
sfx.about: Cura: the healing bloom with a fuller chord under it and the harp taking a longer run.

sfx.name: cure-3
sfx.about: Curaga: light comes down on the whole party — full choir, a harp sweep, bells, and warmth underneath.

sfx.name: regen
sfx.about: Regen: the same mote of light three times over, slower each time, promising to come back.

sfx.name: life
sfx.about: Life: a warm choir swell lifting from the b6 to the tonic, and one bell as they stand up.

sfx.name: full-life

sfx.name: esuna

sfx.name: dispel

sfx.name: protect
sfx.about: Protect: a low bell and a held chord closing around the target like a shield taking weight.

sfx.name: shell
sfx.about: Shell: the same gesture made of air and glass instead of weight — a dome, not a wall.

sfx.name: reflect
sfx.about: Reflect: two glass notes a fifth apart, the second a mirror of the first, ringing together.

sfx.name: reflect-bounce

sfx.name: slow

sfx.name: stop

sfx.name: sleep
sfx.about: Sleep: three drowsy notes falling a step at a time, the last one barely arriving.

sfx.name: silence
sfx.about: Silence: everything is pulled inward and the room is shut — a reversed swell into no tail at all.

sfx.name: blind

sfx.name: poison

sfx.name: berserk

sfx.name: curse

sfx.name: scan

sfx.name: steal-success
sfx.about: Steal: a quick grab of cloth and a bright little jingle getting away with it.

sfx.name: steal-fail
sfx.about: Nothing in the hand: the same grab, then a dull pizzicato thud where the jingle should be.

sfx.name: phoenix-down
